color.note: One theme with two surfaces from the Figma file: the dark teal sidebar and the white top bar. Translucent colours are written as rgba so they sit correctly on their surface.

tokens.name: sidebar-bg
tokens.usage: Solid fill of the sidebar, expanded and collapsed. Everything in the sidebar sits on this.

tokens.name: sidebar-glow
tokens.usage: Decorative blurred ellipses inside the sidebar (see glow-opacity-* and glow-blur-*). Never use for text or icons.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Parent nav item labels, the active sub item label and all nav icons. 13.1:1 on sidebar-bg.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive sub item labels. Exactly 4.5:1 on sidebar-bg — do not go lower, and do not place it over the brightest part of the glow.

tokens.name: text-label
tokens.usage: Uppercase section labels above each group of nav items. 5.1:1 on sidebar-bg.

tokens.name: icon-muted
tokens.usage: Chevrons and the collapse / expand toggle. Baked into those SVGs as stroke-opacity.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline under the sidebar header (logo + toggle).

tokens.name: tree-line
tokens.usage: Vertical guide and 11px branch ticks that connect sub items to their parent.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand lime at full strength. Selection indicator start colour, focus rings, logo highlight. Use for state, never for body text or large fills.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Accent at 5%: the 0.7px border of the active nav item (expanded row and rail square). The selection indicator stays on full accent.

tokens.name: accent-deep
tokens.usage: End stop of the selection indicator gradient (accent → accent-deep).

tokens.name: accent-shade
tokens.usage: Dark stop of the logo mark's gradient. Logo only.

tokens.name: active-fill
tokens.usage: Bright stop of the active item background gradient (at 9%).

tokens.name: active-fill-edge
tokens.usage: Edge stops of the active item background gradient (0% and 96%).

tokens.name: active-inner-glow

tokens.name: surface

tokens.name: ink

tokens.name: ink-muted

tokens.name: ink-subtle

tokens.name: primary

tokens.name: primary-tint

tokens.name: icon-button-bg

tokens.name: divider-control
